gloss: central part; city center; downtown; core

definitions.gloss: central part; city center; downtown; core area
definitions.explanation: The central or inner part of something, most commonly the central area of a city. Also used for the core region of a larger entity such as a country, a building, or an organ of the body.

examples.japanese: {中心部|ちゅうしんぶ}に{住|す}んでいる。
examples.english: I live in the city center.

examples.japanese: {東京|とうきょう}の{中心部|ちゅうしんぶ}は{家賃|やちん}が{高|たか}い。
examples.english: Rents in central Tokyo are high.

examples.japanese: {事故|じこ}のため、{市|し}の{中心部|ちゅうしんぶ}は{大|おお}きく{渋滞|じゅうたい}している。
examples.english: Due to the accident, the city center is heavily congested.

notes:
Composed of {中心|ちゅうしん} (center, middle) and the suffix {〜部|ぶ} (part, section). Refers to the inner or central area of a place, most commonly a city, but also buildings, organs, regions, and organizations. In news and travel writing it is the standard way to say "downtown" or "central (city name)."

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {市|し}の{中心部|ちゅうしんぶ}: city center; downtown
- {都市|とし}の{中心部|ちゅうしんぶ}: urban core
- {東京|とうきょう}の{中心部|ちゅうしんぶ}: central Tokyo
- {中心部|ちゅうしんぶ}に{向|む}かう: head toward the center
- {中心部|ちゅうしんぶ}から{離|はな}れる: move away from the center
- {中心部|ちゅうしんぶ}に{位置|いち}する: be located in the center

SIMILAR WORDS:
- {中心|ちゅうしん}: center — the abstract or geometric center point; more general
- {中心地|ちゅうしんち}: central location; hub — emphasizes being a focal place (of commerce, culture, etc.)
- {都心|としん}: city center — specifically an urban core, often central Tokyo in particular
- {中央|ちゅうおう}: middle, central — a positional or administrative term (e.g., central government)
